newsitem.title: USA: U.S. ITC Commissioner Watson resigns.
newsitem.headline: U.S. ITC Commissioner Watson resigns.

text.p: U.S. Trade Commissioner Peter Watson said Friday he was leaving the U.S. International Trade Commission to take a position with the Center for Strategic and International Studies.
Watson, a Republican from California, was appointed to the commission by President Bush in 1991. He served as chairman of the commission for two years.
He said his resignation will become effective October 31.
